summary: Tested requested auth regressions on preview app for customer/admin login, lockout behavior, browser account navigation, and error message UX. Core requested flows pass; only preflight CORS header behavior remains failing as known infrastructure/gateway issue.

critical.issue: OPTIONS preflight still returns 400 and omits access-control-allow-origin, while allow-credentials=true is present.

action_items: Fix auth preflight behavior so OPTIONS returns 200/204 with explicit access-control-allow-origin and credentials support for preview origin.
After CORS/preflight fix, rerun browser auth checks in strict client mode to confirm no intermittent failures outside same-origin route.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORSMiddleware allow_methods excludes OPTIONS, consistent with repeated preflight 400 outcome.
Auth lockout logic now correctly prioritizes valid credential verification before lockout gate and clears login_attempts on successful sign-in.
server.py is very large and mixes auth/catalog/admin concerns; split into modules to reduce regression risk.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary customer test identity for lockout validation and removed test user + login_attempts record via cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Customer login (p0check_1790113956@example.com/TestPass123!) succeeded repeatedly in API and browser; auth-error-message appears for wrong password and clears immediately on credential edit; profile link reliably opens /account with no 'Package is not defined'/runtime overlay markers; admin deepak143/deepak143 routes to /admin successfully. Only failing check is OPTIONS preflight/CORS headers.
rca of the issue: Repro: send OPTIONS /api/auth/login with Origin=https://dashboard-design-20.preview.emergentagent.com + Access-Control-Request-Method POST + content-type. Result: 400, allow-credentials=true, but missing allow-origin. Code also sets allow_methods without OPTIONS. Likely combined app CORS config plus ingress/gateway handling of preflight. Mitigation: include OPTIONS (or '*') in allow_methods and validate ingress forwards preflight correctly with explicit origin reflection.
